baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional opening at عثر and the paired clause آخران يقومان مقامهما.
baseline_models.mechanism: A concealed failure comes to light as the first pair's procedural stumble; the incurred sin disables their standing, so a matched pair occupies the same evidentiary office.

activation_trace.role: Emergence of a concealed matter makes the condition a forensic disclosure rather than a bare allegation.
The bodily stumble image supplies failure of footing and motivates loss of the first pair's procedural position.
Lagging behind the good casts the sin as failed or delayed fiduciary performance.
Exact standing-in-for another supplies transfer of the evidentiary office to the second pair.

changed_reading.before: Two disqualified witnesses are simply replaced.
changed_reading.after: Discovery initiates a designed reversal in which a hidden procedural fall vacates an office and a matched pair takes it over.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three حق forms, the priority term الأوليان, and the comparative claim شهادتنا أحق.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated حق language moves through incurred obligation, a right borne against someone, and comparative priority. The second pair therefore voices the affected side's counterclaim, not merely a second version of the same report.

activation_trace.role: Fixed obligation links the first pair's incurred sin to a liability that the procedure must answer.
A specifically owned right makes the affected party's stake distributive rather than merely abstract truth.
Mutual assertion of right supplies the adversarial structure behind the two competing testimonies.
Priority and stronger entitlement identify the second speakers by their superior claim to take the procedural position.

changed_reading.before: The second testimony is only asserted to be factually truer.
changed_reading.after: The corrupted first claim generates a counter-entitlement, and the affected side asserts that its testimony has the stronger right to govern the outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath, the two testimony nouns, and the denial وما اعتدينا followed by الظالمين.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath places a knowledge-claim inside a protected boundary. The speakers deny both crossing that boundary and withholding a right, so the closing threat audits the scope and placement of testimony as well as its truthfulness.

activation_trace.role: A formal oath allocated among its bearers makes the claim solemn, shared, and procedurally accountable.
Declarative evidence grounded in knowledge defines what the oath is meant to warrant.
Crossing a limit turns the denial into a claim that the witnesses have not exceeded their evidentiary jurisdiction.
Withholding another's right names the concrete wrong that a false or overreaching testimony would commit.

changed_reading.before: The closing words are a generic assurance that the second pair did nothing wrong.
changed_reading.after: The second pair denies crossing the limits of what they may attest and trapping the claimants' right outside its proper holder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier lawful and prohibited zones repeatedly define transgression as crossing a disclosed limit. That sequence sharpens the focus denial into a claim of procedural non-overreach.

activation_trace.role: Prohibition supplies one side of an explicit legal boundary.
Release from prohibition supplies the permitted side against which overreach can be measured.
Repeated boundary-crossing language directly links legal misclassification to transgression.
Transgression after a test adds the element of crossing a known limit after notice.
The focus denial applies that boundary logic to the rival testimony.

structural_cues: 5:87 places permission, self-made prohibition, and transgression in one sequence; 5:94 repeats transgression after a disclosed trial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated permitted/prohibited edges and post-notice crossing; I map that legal edge onto the evidentiary office in 5:107. The live alternative is that the focus phrase denotes generic moral wrongdoing without a jurisdictional nuance.

changed_reading.before: We did not transgress means only that we did not lie or behave badly.
changed_reading.after: We did not transgress also denies exceeding the right, role, or scope assigned to the counter-witnesses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier oath rule distinguishes idle speech from deliberately bound oaths and commands their preservation; the later sequence allows oaths to follow and answer prior oaths. The focus oath is thus a binding but challengeable evidentiary instrument.

activation_trace.role: The oath sense identifies repeated sworn speech as a regulated legal act.
Binding and ratifying an undertaking supplies enforceability rather than mere emphasis.
Protecting a covenant makes oath-keeping an ongoing custody obligation.
Oaths following prior oaths show that sworn evidence can be procedurally answered rather than simply sealing the case.
The focus pair's formal oath is the local instrument placed inside that wider binding-and-answering system.

structural_cues: 5:89 contrasts unbound oath speech with deliberately bound oaths and provides repair; 5:108 explicitly sequences one set of oaths after another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding, preservation, repair, and a second oath sequence; I infer that the focus oath carries a reversible procedural burden. It may instead function only as solemn corroboration, with no transfer of burden implied.

changed_reading.before: The second pair's oath is a one-way seal on their assertion.
changed_reading.after: The oath is a regulated and answerable instrument that shifts the burden after the first sworn account fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hunting-liability procedure uses judged equivalence and two just assessors to substitute an answering value for a violation. The witness procedure repeats the just pair, and the focus adds another pair standing in place, activating procedural compensation for corrupted evidence.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing for another supplies a compensatory substitution pattern.
Equivalence requires the substitute to answer the original loss rather than merely follow it.
Adjudication between people makes the equivalence a determined legal relation.
Equality and matching connect just assessors with an answering equivalent.
Joining one to one creates the paired unit that the focus procedure later duplicates.
Justice in judgment qualifies the original witness pair and links the two legal procedures structurally.
The focus pair's standing in place converts equivalent substitution into an evidentiary remedy.

structural_cues: 5:95 has two just persons determine an equivalent response to a violation; 5:106 has two just persons hold testimony; 5:107 answers their failure with another pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two-person adjudication, equivalence, and explicit substitution; I transfer that compensatory logic from material liability to evidentiary repair. The alternative is that the shared pair formula is formal parallelism without a common mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The second pair merely supersedes untrustworthy speakers.
changed_reading.after: The counter-pair functions as an answering equivalent that restores procedural balance after the first pair has distorted a right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from what is made visible or concealed, through the ban on concealing testimony, to testimony delivered on its proper face and the possibility of rejecting prior oaths. This turns the focus discovery into an error-correcting disclosure path.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and emergence establish the visible pole of the disclosure mechanism.
Concealment supplies the hidden state from which evidence must be recovered.
The witnesses' explicit denial of concealment localizes that hidden-visible contrast inside the testimony procedure.
The correct aspect of a matter gives recovered testimony its proper orientation.
Rejecting what is false or defective supplies the corrective action applied to the prior oath.
A concealed trace disturbed into visibility gives the focus discovery a material evidentiary texture.
A sign that bears witness lets the surfaced trace support correction of the human account.

structural_cues: 5:99 pairs disclosure with concealment; 5:106 forbids concealed testimony; 5:108 joins proper-facing testimony to rejection of prior oaths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden and visible poles, a non-concealment pledge, proper orientation, and rejection; I connect them as a disclosure-to-correction pipeline. A live alternative is that proper face means only accurate verbal performance, not recovery of hidden evidence.

changed_reading.before: A chance discovery simply triggers a fresh witness pair.
changed_reading.after: A concealed trace is surfaced, oriented into proper testimony, and used to reject or correct the defective sworn account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later interrogation separates finite witnesses from knowledge of the hidden, then explicitly limits witnesshood to the duration of presence and transfers watching after removal. The focus claim of being more حق becomes comparative epistemic standing, not possession of total truth.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure distinguishes what finite respondents can know from what the knower of hidden things knows.
What is screened from sight marks the epistemic region unavailable to ordinary witnesses.
Witnesshood grounded in presence supplies the condition under which testimony has jurisdiction.
Duration bounds that witnessing presence in time.
Taking the person away terminates the first witness's direct observational office.
Ongoing observation after the transfer supplies a distinct and superior watching office.
Truth matching reality remains the focus standard, while the comparative form ranks access to it.

structural_cues: 5:109 has questioned messengers disclaim knowledge before the knower of hidden things; 5:117 states a witness-duration clause and then transfers watching after removal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite knowledge, hidden knowledge, presence-bounded witnesshood, and transferred watching; I map that epistemic hierarchy onto the local comparison of testimonies. The alternative is that local witnesses may know through custody or transmission without direct presence.

changed_reading.before: Our testimony is more حق asserts unrestricted possession of the truth.
changed_reading.after: Our testimony has the stronger warrant within a bounded field of presence, access, and procedural standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a material pack-load image into adjudication. It remains anchored in the matched pair standing in place and in the packet's repeated just pairs; downstream prose should present it only as a structural analogy for counterweight, not as the lexical meaning of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The matched substitution in آخران يقومان مقامهما.

activation_trace.role: Standing exactly where another stood supplies the replacement side of the balancing mechanism.
A load balancing another load materializes the answering equivalent as a counterweight.
Applying the same balance image to the first witness pair lets the second pair occupy the opposite evidentiary side.
One joined to one fixes the stable paired unit needed for a matched counterload.

changed_reading.before: The two later witnesses only replace the first two sequentially.
changed_reading.after: The second pair can be carried as an exploratory counterload that rebalances the evidentiary weight borne by the first pair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines dust-trace, witnessing-sign, and penetrating-thrust branches into a forensic material analogy. It remains anchored in عثر, شهادة, and أحق within the focus ayah; downstream prose should qualify it as an exploratory image of evidentiary force, not claim that nonhuman trace evidence is the verse's settled referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence from عثر to the comparative شهادتنا أحق.

activation_trace.role: A hidden trace stirred into visibility supplies evidence independent of the rival speakers' assertions.
A mark that testifies allows the discovered trace to function as corroborating sign.
A straight thrust that penetrates supplies the exploratory image of evidence reaching through a defective surface account.

changed_reading.before: Only one human statement defeats another human statement.
changed_reading.after: A surfaced trace may be carried as a witnessing sign whose evidentiary force penetrates the first pair's account.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes an error-correcting reversal: concealed failure is surfaced, the first pair's office is vacated, and a matched counterpair restores the affected side's claim.
The oath is a bound but answerable evidentiary instrument rather than a one-way seal.
More rightful testimony is comparative and jurisdiction-bounded by presence and access rather than a claim to omniscience.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated two-person adjudication, equivalent substitution, returned oaths, and the later transfer from finite witness to continuing watcher made the focus read as a compact protocol for correcting corrupted testimony. Material branches preserved distinct counterload and trace-evidence outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic direction of the affected group and the priority term remains open, so the exact holder of the counter-entitlement is not fully resolved.
The transfer from compensatory equivalence to evidentiary counterweight may be a structural analogy rather than a shared legal mechanism.
Presence-bounded witnesshood may illuminate comparative warrant without strictly governing the local witnesses' competence.
